key_features: Designed for Sensitive Skin: Vanicream is the #1 Dermatologist Recommended Brand for Sensitive Skin*. Carefully formulated to be non-comedogenic, this moisturizer helps support skin prone to sensitivity or eczema

Hydrating Moisturizer: This rich but lightweight face moisturizer is formulated with hyaluronic acid and 5 key ceramides which help hydrate and retain skin’s moisture. Designed to wear under makeup or as part of an am & pm skincare routine

No Common Irritants: The gentle formula contains no gluten, fragrance, dye, lanolin, parabens, botanical extracts, essential oils or other common skin irritants. A non-irritating daily moisturizer suitable for women or men, day or night

Won’t Clog Pores: This fast-absorbing, pH balanced face lotion delivers long-lasting moisture without greasy heaviness. Skin is left feeling soft and deeply moisturized. Directions: Apply as needed day or night or as directed by a physician

Dermatologist-Tested: Awarded the Seal of Acceptance from the National Eczema Association, Vanicream Daily Facial Moisturizer contains ingredients that are essential components of the skin and benefit all skin types

The Most Important Ingredient is Trust: For over 50 years, we have been committed to offering skin care products that meet the needs of sensitive skin and deliver dependable results. Each formula is made with care and backed by decades of skin health expertise
review_summary: Vanicream Daily Facial Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid and 5 Key CeramidesVanicream Facial Moisturizer is formulated with hyaluronic acid and five essential ceramides. It helps restore skin’s natural barrier, while delivering lightweight, long-lasting moisture. Whether you wear it under makeup or use as part of your morning and nighttime skincare routine, the rich, lightweight texture leaves your skin feeling soft, and deeply moisturized.Dermatologist-tested and accepted by the National Eczema Association, this gentle formula contains ingredients that are essential components of the skin and benefit all skin types.
